readme:
> **An Xposed module designed to customize and enhance the Nothing OS experience.** By leveraging the modern Xposed framework, this module injects deep system-level tweaks allowing you to tailor your Nothing device exactly to your liking. ## 🌐 [Source Code & Support](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/NothingTweaks)

## ✨ Features Nothing Tweaks comes packed with a variety of modifications to elevate your Nothing OS experience. _Click any section below to expand and view the available tweaks:_
📱 Status Bar
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Status Bar Brightness Slider** | Slide horizontally across the status bar to smoothly adjust screen brightness. | | **Double Tap to Sleep** | Double tap the status bar to turn off the screen. | | **Status Bar Edge Padding** | Adjust left and right edge spacing of the status bar content to match your display corners. | | **Notification Icon Limit** | Set the maximum number of notification icons shown in the status bar and AOD. | | **Nothing Earphone Icon** | Replaces the generic Bluetooth status bar icon with the official Nothing earbud glyph whenever any Bluetooth audio device is connected. |
⏰ Status Bar Clock
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Show Seconds** | Displays real-time seconds in the status bar clock. | | **Show Day of Week** | Prepends the abbreviated weekday (e.g. `Mon 10:10`) to the status bar clock. | | **Custom Text** | Appends custom text after the status bar time (up to 24 characters). |
📶 Network Speed Indicator
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Network Speed Indicator** | Display real-time upload and download speeds directly in the status bar. | | **Indicator Position** | Choose placement next to the Clock (Left) or next to Battery & System Icons (Right). | | **Display Mode** | Switch between combined total speed (e.g. `1.2 MB/s`) or separate upload and download rates (e.g. `▲ 20K ▼ 1.2M`). | | **Auto-hide When Inactive** | Automatically hides the indicator when network is idle (< 1 KB/s) to keep the status bar uncluttered. | | **Show Activity Arrows** | Display sleek `▲` and `▼` directional arrows instead of text labels (Separate mode only). |
⚙️ Device Features
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Palm Touch Sleep** | Turn off the screen by covering the display with your palm on the lockscreen. | | **Flip to Record** | Flip the phone face-down to automatically start voice recording. | | **Super Volume Boost** | Enables a higher maximum audio volume ceiling. | | **Stepless Volume** | Unlocks continuous, granular volume adjustment levels. |
🧭 Navigation
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Long Swipe Back to Kill App** | Hold the back swipe gesture and release to immediately kill and force-stop the foreground application. | | **Hide Keyboard Space** | Removes the blank space beneath the keyboard and hides the navigation bar handle while typing. | | **Hide Nav Bar (with Circle to Search)** | Hides the navigation bar gesture pill completely while preserving all gesture navigation and Circle to Search functionality. |
🔒 Lockscreen
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Double Tap to Sleep** | Double tap any empty area on the lockscreen to immediately turn off the screen. | | **Double Tap to Wake** | Double tap the screen while screen is off or in AOD to wake the device. | | **Additional Charging Info** | Displays real-time wattage (W), current (mA), voltage (V), and battery temperature (°C) while charging. Positioned 10dp above the fingerprint/lock icon. | | **Scramble PIN** | Randomizes the positions of the PIN keypad digits on every unlock attempt. | | **Skip Power-Off Verification** | Allows powering off or restarting the device from the lock screen without entering your PIN/password. | | **Hide Clock** | Hides the stock lockscreen clock and widgets (smartspace), ideal for third-party depth effect wallpapers. | | **Remove Glimpse Ads** | Disables the sponsored Glance / Glimpse magazine wallpaper on the lock screen. |
🤖 AI & Miscellaneous
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Both Volume Keys for Torch** | Press both volume buttons together when the screen is off to toggle the flashlight. | | **Disable Safe Volume Warning** | Permanently disables the high-volume warning dialog and volume limit when increasing headphone volume. | | **Gemini AI Clipboard Chip** | Redirects the Nothing OS clipboard AI action chip to Google Gemini instead of ChatGPT. | | **Volume Panel Timeout** | Customize the duration (in milliseconds) before the volume slider automatically dismisses (default: 3000 ms). | | **Disable Temperature Warnings** | Disables intrusive high-temperature system warning dialogs. |
📸 Screenshots & Screen Recording
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Allow Screenshots & Recording Everywhere** | Allows taking screenshots, screen recording, and casting in restricted apps and throughout the system, while blocking screenshot and recording detection. | | **Screen Recording Quality Clamp** | Force the built-in screen recorder to clamp at 720p or 1080p @ 60fps for smoother or lower-bandwidth recordings. | | **Screenshot Serial Number** | Optionally watermarks your device serial number (`SN: `) onto captured screenshots. |
👆 In-Display Fingerprint
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Color Scanning Dots** | Re-colors the animated scanning ripple dots around your finger during biometric authentication. | | **Custom Color Picker** | Choose any custom static color via a built-in color picker (when random mode is off). | | **Random Color Every Tap** | Automatically rolls a fresh, vibrant color every time you touch the fingerprint scanner. |
🛠️ System
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Advanced Power Menu** | Adds direct reboot options for Recovery and Bootloader / Fastboot to the power menu. | | **Allow 180° Rotation** | Allows the screen to rotate completely upside-down (reverse portrait). |
🔋 Battery & Charging
| Feature | Description | | :--- | :--- | | **Charging Limit** | Automatically pauses charging when the battery reaches your chosen percentage to prevent cell degradation and prolong overall battery lifespan. | | **Stop Charging At (Limit Slider)** | Adjustable threshold slider from 50% to 95% (in 5% steps) with smart hysteresis charging resumption when battery drops by 2%. | | **Charging Paused Notification** | Displays a status notification whenever charging is paused at the set limit. | | **Why Cap at 80% Guide** | Built-in expandable guide detailing why limiting high voltage (>80% / 4.2V+) relieves electrochemical stress on the cathode and doubles cycle life. |
## 🚀 Installation 1. Ensure your device is rooted and **[LSPosed](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)** is installed. 2. Download the latest Nothing Tweaks APK from the **[Releases](https://github.com/RevealedSoulEven/NothingTweaks/releases/)** page and install it. 3. Open the **LSPosed Manager** app and enable the Nothing Tweaks module. 4. Reboot your device (or restart `SystemUI` and `Nothing Launcher`) to apply the changes. 5. Open the **Nothing Tweaks** app to configure your settings! ## 🤝 Credits & Acknowledgements This project would not have been possible without the amazing work of the Android modding community. Special thanks to: * **[rovo89](https://github.com/rovo89)** - For creating the original [Xposed Framework](https://github.com/rovo89/Xposed), which pioneered this level of Android customization. * **[LSPosed Team](https://github.com/LSPosed/LSPosed)** - For maintaining and advancing the modern ART hooking framework that powers this module today. * **[Rares6567](https://github.com/Rares6567)** - For _"hide space under keyboard"_ feature. And his project [NothingXpert](https://github.com/Rares6567/NothingXpert). * **[LSPosed/DisableFlagSecure](https://github.com/LSPosed/DisableFlagSecure)** - For the logic and research behind bypassing screenshot / screen recording detection.
--- *Disclaimer: This module modifies system-level components. Use it at your own risk.*
